newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser raises SPH.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fraser raises SPH.

text.p: Fraser Securities Ltd said on Monday it had raised Singapore Press Holdings Ltd to a hold for the foreign tranche and a buy for the local tranche.

"We are revising slightly upwards our earlier profit forecast from Singapore $340.6 million to S$342 million for fiscal year 1997 and S$376.7 million to S$380 million for fiscal year 1998 due to contributions from the latest property acquisitions," Fraser said in a research note.
On Friday, SPH announced it would lead a venture to buy a shopping complex in Singapore for S$682.3 million.
At S$12.90 for the local shares and S$26.50 for the foreign shares, SPH was trading at a prospective price earning ratio of 13 times and 26 times respectively, Fraser said.
